# Hand-verified against Super Mario Strikers' decomp-derived table, by reading
# both disassemblies side by side. Every one of these is structurally identical
# to the reference function -- same prologue, same SDK constants, same
# write-gather-pipe opcodes -- differing only in the small-data base register
# (r13 here, r2 there) and the offsets inside __GXData.
#
# They are here rather than in the automatic output because no signature
# database carries them and the September 2002 SDK changed them enough that an
# exact fingerprint does not transfer.
GXBegin           0x8019DA28
GXSetArray        0x8019CAD8
GXCopyDisp        0x8019E8AC
GXCopyTex         0x8019EA08
GXCallDisplayList 0x801A2A50
GXLoadTexObj      0x801A0114
GXLoadTlut        0x801A01F4
